_readme: Settings for the fishing game. Change numbers here; no code change needed. catchesToWin: correct fish needed to finish. maxDifferentLetters: how many different letters swim in one game (the target included). targetChance: 0..1, how often a new fish carries the target letter. swimSeconds: how long a fish takes to cross the screen (bigger = slower). swimDirection: 'ltr' (left to right), 'rtl', or 'both' (lanes alternate). Stars: a mistake is a wrong catch, or (if countMissedAsMistake) a target fish that swam away. 0..threeStarsMaxMistakes = 3 stars, up to twoStarsMaxMistakes = 2 stars, more = 1 star. fishImages: painted fish (facing right), made by tools/games/process_fishing.py; when empty the fish are drawn in code. fishLetterSpot: where the letter goes on those images (center x/y and size, as fractions of the image; the script prints it). background: the Nile picture (drawn in code when missing). backgroundMarks: where things are in that picture, as fractions of its height (y) or width (x): top of the underwater part, top of the grassy banks, middle of each bank, right edge of the left bank, top of the sand.
